questions.prompt: A developer tries 40 prompt variants on the same 20 examples and ships the one that scored 100%. What's the main problem?

options.text: The winning score is inflated by luck on those examples; there's no held-out data to confirm it
100% accuracy is impossible for any prompt

questions.explanation: Selecting and reporting on the same examples overfits. Choose on a validation set and report on a separate held-out test set.

questions.prompt: Which are limitations of automatic prompt engineering noted in the lesson? Select all that apply.

options.text: The space of possible prompts is huge, so naive search is inefficient
Optimizing on a biased dataset or metric bakes in that bias
It can only produce prompts in English

questions.explanation: Search efficiency, biased metrics, and missing human judgment are the main limits; mitigate with smarter search, fairness checks, and human review.

questions.prompt: Examples used only once, at the end, to report an unbiased score for the chosen prompt form the held-out ____ set.
questions.explanation: A held-out test set gives an honest estimate because it played no part in choosing the prompt.

questions.prompt: What did the APE paper (Zhou et al., 2022) find?

options.text: Automatically generated instructions matched or beat human-written ones on 19 of 24 tasks
Human prompts always beat automatic ones
Automatic prompts only work for image models
Prompt wording has no effect on performance

questions.explanation: APE treated the instruction as a program to optimize and found instructions that rivaled human ones on most tasks.

questions.prompt: Order the steps of an APE-style optimization.

items.text: Report the winner's score on the held-out test set
Have a model propose candidate instructions
Score each candidate on the validation set

questions.explanation: Propose, score on validation, select, then confirm on untouched test data.

questions.prompt: Match each meta-prompting use to its purpose.

pairs.right: Draft a new prompt from a task description
Create candidates that test specific hypotheses
Run a proven prompt on triggers with validation and review

questions.explanation: Meta-prompting speeds up drafting, critique, and candidate generation; proven prompts then graduate into workflows.
